facts.fact: The StackAdapt article 'Are your campaigns really using AI? 10 questions to ask your DSP' was published on 2019-04-30.
StackAdapt's article presents 10 questions advertisers can ask their DSP to check whether its AI is effective for campaigns.
facts.quote: Now, I share 10 questions to ask your DSP—so you can be sure your campaigns can leverage AI effectively.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that up to 73% of clicks on an ad could be poor quality, fraudulent, or duplicate requests, as an illustrative example of why fraud detection matters.
facts.quote: It may appear as though your ad is getting a ton of clicks, but really, 73% could be poor quality, fraudulent, or duplicate requests.
